buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1.1. 1.1. Online electronic bid (e-tender) at GeM portal under “Two Packet Bid system” is invited on be half of NHPC Limited (A Government of India Navratna Enterprise) from domestic bidders registered in Indi a, for the work i.e. “Annual Maintenance Contract for 02 Years of Passenger Lift (Real Make) inst alled at Dam site of Parbati-III Power Station”. 1.2. (A) Instant bid type is “Two Packet Bid”, so bidder/seller is advised to upload/quote financial offer in its financial bid only as where applicable at GeM Portal. (B) Utmost care shall be taken by bidder/seller while uploading technical bid documents at GeM Portal that it should not contain “Financial offer/Price bid” in any form. The bidder/seller are cautioned that uploading financial offer or disclosing/revealing its quoted price in any form i n its technical bid document will result in rejection of tender. 1.3. The bidder is advised to visit the site at their own cost before participating in the bidding process to full y understand the actual site conditions, scope of work, access, existing installed equipment etc. By submit ting the bid, the bidder shall be deemed to have satisfied themselves regarding the site and work requirem ents and shall not subsequently claim lack of knowledge, insufficient information etc. as a basis for any ad ditional cost or time.

1.4. Eligibility Criteria for Bidder: (A) Bids of those Bidders who have not submitted the EMD as sought under “EMD Details of B id Document” shall not be considered for evaluation, except in case of exemption. The bidd er seeking EMD exemption, must submit the valid supporting document for the relevant cat egory as per GeM GTC with the bid. Under MSE category, only Service Providers for Services are eligible for exemption from EMD. Traders are excluded from the purview of this Policy. (B) All bidders meeting Qualification criteria as defined in clause 1.5. 1.5. Qualification Criteria i. Average annual financial turnover during the last three (03) financial years ending 31st March of pre vious financial year should be not below the amount indicated under bid details. ii. Bidder must have successfully executed /completed at least one single order of 80 % of the Annualiz ed Estimated Cost or 2 orders each of 50% of the Annualized Estimated Cost or 3 orders each of 40 % of th e Annualized Estimated Cost for similar service(s) in last Seven (07) years. · Similar Service is defined as, “SITC/R&M/AMC of Passenger Lift” · (Annualized Estimated Cost= Total Estimated Cost/ Period of Completion in years (n)) Note: a) In case period of the completion is less than 1 year then value of (n) will be considere d as 1. b) The reference date for considering the period of preceding Seven (07) Years for gener al & specific technical experience shall be the last day of the month previous to the on e in which Tenders are invited. iii. In case of bidder having work experience for “SITC of Passenger Lift”, Copies of contracts / work o rders for satisfactorily completed or satisfactory performance certificate issued by the employer for the wo rk done/performed as a Prime Contractor in its support is/are to be uploaded with the bid for verification b y the Buyer. iv. In case of bidder having work experience for “R&M/AMC of Passenger Lift”, Copies of contracts / work orders for satisfactorily completed or satisfactory performance certificate issued by the employer for the work done/performed, for not less than one year as a Prime Contractor in its support is/are to be uploa ded with the bid for verification by the Buyer. v. In case of experience certificates produced by the bidders for having executed works/service for Priv ate Organizations, TDS Certificates/Annual Information Statement (AIS)/Form 26AS shall also be produced along with experience certificates. 1.6. Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid. (i) Notarized power of attorney of the signatory of the Bid to commit the Bidder with a uthority of the executant to execute the same. (ii) Copy of PAN Card

(iii) Copy of GSTIN (iv) Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank (v) Declaration of Ineligibility: Annexure-III (vi) Undertaking by bidder towards Anti-Profiteering Clause: Annexure-V (vii) Self Certificate for Local Content: Annexure-VI (viii) Declaration for insolvency proceedings under IBC 2016: Annexure - VII (ix) SA Code of Services: Annexure- VIII 1.7. Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any respo nsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actual or as per applicable rates (whichever is lo wer) subject to the maximum of quoted GST%. 1.8. Contractor shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee on ly. . 2. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of NHPC LIMITED payable at BHUNTAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 3. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Banker’s Cheque in favour of NHPC LIMITED payable at BHUNTAR . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the BC along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name NHPC LIMITED Account No. 11038719758 IFSC Code SBIN0003633 Bank Name STATE BANK OF INDIA Branch address BHUNTAR . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC
